note: Re-judged 2026-10-31 by an independent auditor who authored none of the change. RFC text (rfc1997): "The following communities have global significance and their operations shall be implemented in any community-attribute-aware BGP speaker." be95c10053 gave the wkPeer fixture explicit accepting import and export policies (FinalAccept, no refs) for an EBGP peer, and reworded TestForwardWellKnownNeedsNoOperatorPolicy's comment and precondition from 'no operator export policy' to 'export policy names NO operator filter'. Under RFC 8212 an EBGP destination with no policy refuses everything, so the old precondition can no longer hold on a delivering session; the precondition still pins that no filter, community-match rule or in-process egress filter exists, so the NO_EXPORT/NO_ADVERTISE suppression the test asserts still comes from the wire values alone, which is what 'shall be implemented' asks. Assertions unchanged. Verdict unchanged: enforced. Earlier judgements are in this file's git history.
